This instant criminal misc. petition has been filed by the petitioners against the order dated 19.04.2023 passed by learned Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate (PCPNDT),
Jodhpur Metro in Criminal Case No.33/2021 (NCV No.2375/2021) in FIR No.102/2020 registered at Mahila Police Station, District Jodhpur West and all consequential proceedings for offences under Section 498-A and 406 of IPC on the basis of compromise entered between the parties.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: [CRLMP-2344/2023] Counsel for the parties submit that the petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2/complainant are husband and wife.

They have entered into a compromise in the spirit of Lok Adalat and settled their dispute amicably, therefore, the criminal proceedings offence under Section 498-A IPC may be quashed on the basis of compromise.

Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case, since the petitioner and complainant have arrived at compromise and settled their dispute and in the view of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex court in the case of B.S. Joshi Vs. State of Haryana, reported in 2003 (4) SCC p.675 in Rahul Jain vs State Of Rajasthan on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187600109/
1 which it has been held that the proceedings under Section 498A IPC can be quashed because it is the matrimonial matter, the criminal proceedings for offence under Section 498-A IPC are liable to be quashed.

sentences.text:
Accordingly, the present misc. petition is allowed qua the petitioners and order dated 19.04.2023 passed by learned Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate (PCPNDT), Jodhpur Metro in Criminal Case No.33/2021 (NCV No.2375/2021) in FIR No.102/2020 registered at Mahila Police Station,
District Jodhpur West and all consequential proceedings for offences under Section 498-A and 406 of IPC are hereby quashed on the basis of compromise deed.
(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 67-Rashi/-
